title: Reference Laboratory Panel Pricing: Multi-Test Reduction on Self-Pay Estimates
content:
A self-pay Laboratory Test Orders accession of the Esoteric Reference Testing class carrying several tests receives a multi-test reduction on its reference-testing self-pay estimate.

Tests are counted as standing on the accession when they have an ordered charge line or an accepted add-on line that has not been credited.

| Tests standing on the accession | Estimate reduced by |
|---|---|
| Four or more | 12 percent of the test price sum |
| Two or three | 4 percent of the test price sum |
| One | nothing |

**Clause.** When four or more tests stand on the accession, the estimate is reduced by 12 percent of the test price sum as a multi-test reduction. When two or three tests stand on it, the estimate is reduced by 4 percent of the test price sum. A single test takes no multi-test reduction.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical, test price sum of 500.00).**

- Three tests stand: reduced by 20.00. An accepted add-on then makes four tests, and the reduction becomes 12 percent of the new test price sum.
- Two ordered tests, one of them credited: one test stands, so there is no multi-test reduction.
